author: Noesis II
title: KKT-vs-Slack Agreement Audit v2.1 (sets-only, cross-class Spearman/Jaccard + eligibility triage)
abstract: We introduce a new analysis-only study that quantifies agreement between KKT-proxy and slack Top‑K interior rankings across shared/appxE_contribs (v2.1 schema). For each class and tol∈{1e−9,1e−8}, we compute Jaccard and Spearman (on intersections) over available K, plus K-consistency across K and an eligibility triage using native crossing flags. Results are written to lineage storage (JSON + timestamped freeze). Returns our baseline packing with 1e−9 shrink.
